Brussels Playbook Podcast Stories driving the day in Brussels and beyond.
Apple Music Amazon Music Europe’s sports rulebook is getting an update. EU Sports Commissioner Glenn Micallef joins us to discuss illegal sports streaming, the future of FIFA President Gianni Infantino and the controversy over Russian athletes returning to international competitions.
Also on the podcast: Zoya and Ian discuss the EU’s upcoming 22nd round of sanctions against Russia and growing questions over how well existing measures are enforced.
And our colleague Sonja Rijnen takes us inside the fiercely competitive — and sometimes bizarre — exam process for landing a job at the EU institutions.
Did you take the AD5 exam for a shot at working at the EU institutions? How did it go? Let us know by messaging us on WhatsApp here or at +32 491 05 06 29.
